name: uptimerobot
description: Monitor websites, APIs, and servers — create monitors, triage incidents, and query uptime stats. Supports HTTP, keyword, ping, port, heartbeat, DNS, API, and UDP monitors.

interface.longDescription: Create and manage UptimeRobot monitors, triage incidents, and query uptime stats through the hosted UptimeRobot MCP server. Supports HTTP, keyword, ping, port, heartbeat, DNS, API, and UDP monitors, plus status pages, maintenance windows, monitor groups, and alert contacts. Sign in with your UptimeRobot account (OAuth, no API key). The plugin acts only on the account you authorize, read-only accounts get only the read tools, and some tools need features your UptimeRobot plan includes.
